result.headline: No clear control fault: pitch 'divergence' is sign/lag mismatch; low-voltage and sensor-health errors at 1.325 s unexplained.
result.explanation: Pitch attitude mirrors its setpoint (correlation -0.987 at 0.974 s lag), so the tracking anomaly looks like a convention and lag artifact. A battery warning and sensor-health error at t=1.325 s remain unexplained.

evidence.quote: EVENT t=1.325 s controller.event[mavros: Battery] mavros: Battery: WARN: Low voltage
evidence.shows: Battery warning at the same instant as a sensor-health error. No voltage series exists to check it.

evidence.quote: EVENT t=1.325 s controller.event[mavros: System] mavros: System: ERROR: Sensor helth
evidence.shows: Sensor-health error with no sensor named. It fires after the setpoint steps at 0.573 s.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT vehicle.airspeed = 0 for the whole recording (319 samples)
evidence.shows: Airspeed is 0 while the vehicle moves at about 12-13 m/s. The sensor is absent, dead or not reported, and may be the unnamed sensor behind the health error.

evidence.quote: TRACKING vehicle.attitude[pitch] followed its setpoint worse from t=0 to 10 s: typical |error| up to 33.073 deg against 6.193 over the whole recording
evidence.shows: Apparent pitch error. The relation check shows correlation -0.987 at a 0.974 s lag in 0-10 s and -0.927 in 10-26 s: inverted sign plus lag, not lost control.

evidence.quote: CHANGE control.attitude_setpoint[roll] at t=0.573 s: 7.84 -> 33.13 deg (step 25.29, 133.1x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: Commanded roll step at t=0.573 s, then vehicle roll stepped at 0.834 s (line 55). The setpoint led the response, which suggests a commanded manoeuvre.

checked.check: Pitch setpoint vs attitude, 0-10 s and 10-26 s
checked.result: Correlation -0.78 and -0.469 at zero lag. At a 0.974 s lag they are -0.987 and -0.927. The error is large only where the setpoint is large.

checked.check: Earliest departure from baseline in 0-4 s
checked.result: No signal left baseline in order (baseline of 0.3 s too short). The only events are the two at t=1.325 s.

checked.check: Actuator outputs vs setpoint movement, 0-3 s
checked.result: ch[2] ramps 1476 -> 1204 us as the pitch setpoint goes 0.2 -> -19. ch[3] and ch[4] spike at 0.415 s, then settle. These are commanded outputs, so they follow the setpoint.

effects.quote: TRACKING vehicle.attitude[pitch] diverged from its setpoint from t=1.516 to 6.071 s (peak |error| 37.095 deg)
effects.why: Follows the large pitch setpoint swing; consistent with sign inversion plus lag.

effects.quote: TRACKING vehicle.attitude[roll] diverged from its setpoint from t=0.34 to 0.934 s (peak |error| 34.283 deg)
effects.why: The setpoint stepped to about 35 at 0.468 s and the attitude reached 27 at 1.103 s, so this is the response delay.
